items.summary: 53 million puts it above any Call of Duty game
items.content:

In the least surprising bit of news of 2026, GTA 6 is selling pretty well. It was probably the most anticipated game ever and is the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic, so naturally the sales have followed. The first official number from Rockstar Games placed it at 32.5 million copies sold before it was even released , which had made it the 30th best-selling game ever above the likes of Super Mario Odyssey, Monster Hunter World, and Elden Ring. But that was just pre-release, so it's no shock to say that its fortunes haven't ended there.

Alinea Analytics' head of market analysis, Rhys Elliott, posts the latest estimate over on Twitter, which places Rockstar's latest at 53 million copies sold, making $4.7 billion in its first week.

If this number is accurate, GTA 6 is the 13th best-selling game ever, with it unseating Animal Crossing: New Horizons, and overtaking the likes of Cyberpunk 2077, The Sims, and the Pokemon Generation 1 games (which have a combined sales figure of 47.44 million across Red, Blue and Yellow).

GTA 6 has sold 53M copies (75.7% on PS5) after a week on the market (@alineaanalytics estimates). Some other quick stats from our estimates: - It's made $4.7B (76.1% on PS5, due to regional prices) - 7M players have already played for over 50 hours. - 250K folks have played for over 100 hours (!!!!) - The US accounts for 33.5% of PS5's GTA 6 copies. Publishing another big deep dive on Substack shortly. November 27, 2026

Elliott's data also estimates that just under a quarter of GTA 6 sales were on Xbox, with the Series X|S version accounting for 13 million vs PS5's 40 million. And it's not like it's just selling well either, as he reckons that seven million players have already played over 50 hours, with 250k of those having already played 100 hours. For reference, the game had been out in New Zealand around 219 hours at the time the tweet was posted.

GTA 6 sales are almost at 25 million as Rockstar earns $2.36 billion in revenue, analysts estimate GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies before it was even released – Elden Ring sold 30 million in 3 years GTA 6 is officially the "most pre-ordered game" in PlayStation and Xbox store history Obviously, this is massively impressive no matter how you look at it. But it's worth keeping in mind that the PC release hasn't even dropped yet, so this has the potential to skyrocket once more when PC players – and console players who are going to double dip – get their hands on it.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 sequel lands surprise update as Project Orion launch window grows more visible
items.summary: Cyberpunk 2's launch date may have been narrowed down...
items.content:
Cyberpunk 2 now has an approximate launch window thanks to a new CD Projekt Red investors call.

The Cyberpunk 2077 sequel, currently known as Cyberpunk 2 or Project Orion, is reportedly shifting into full-production soon. This gives us a good idea of when it’ll launch.

It honestly feels like it’s too early to be talking about another Cyberpunk game , as it does months of hard work and post-launch support to get the current game to its now-excellent state.

On top of that CD Projekt Red’s next game is confirmed to be The Witcher IV , which is expected to launch in 2028 and is apparently borrowing something from Grand Theft Auto VI…

However, in a new investor’s call CD Projekt Red’s Vice President CD Karolina Gnaś confirmed the studio will be increasing its staff next year, and that can only mean one thing…

Using The Witcher IV we can somewhat gleam how long it’ll take for CD Projekt Red to finish its next Cyberpunk game, but don’t take this as the gospel truth as there’s a little bit of speculation involved – and a lot of wishful thinking.

The Witcher IV entered full-production in 2024, and is now set for launch sometime in 2028 provided there are no delays.

At the earliest, Cyberpunk 2 could enter production sometime in 2027, and based on CD Projekt Red’s previous production windows we could see it launch as soon as 2031.

The more likely scenario is it enters production either next year, or early 2028, and then launches around 2032/2033, but we’re optimists here at GAMINGbible.

Despite being widely different IPs and genres both The Witcher IV and Cyberpunk 2 are both intended to be grand open-world games, so it’s safe to say their development cycles won’t be all that different from one another. Cyberpunk 2 might need a little extra time so the studio doesn’t repeat the mistakes of the past…

Again, take all of this with a pinch of salt, but CD Projekt Red bolstering its workforce next year is a pretty good indication that new projects are being set in motion, and some of those workers are actually modders the studio head-hunted.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2 Gets New Development Update From CD Projekt, And It Sounds Promising
items.summary: CDPR has shared new information about its development on the Cyberpunk 2077 sequel, but don't expect it to release soon.
items.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google CD Projekt Red has shared a new update this week on the development of its sequel to Cyberpunk 2077 , and it sounds quite promising. Although The Witcher 4 is the main focus of CDPR right now , the studio hasn’t shied away from the fact that it’s working on a follow-up to Cyberpunk 2077 as well. And while we’re likely still quite far away from seeing Cyberpunk 2 in action, the studio has now shared new information on where it’s at in development.

Detailed in a new call with investors , CD Projekt Red VP Karolina Gnaś briefly touched on Cyberpunk 2 and how the project is going. Although Gnaś didn’t say anything definitively about when the game would be shown off, she did say that CD Projekt Red is planning to staff up more heavily throughout 2027. The implication is that these new hires will be brought in to work specifically on Cyberpunk 2 , which suggests the game should enter production either next year or in 2028.

“[The team is] making good progress with Cyberpunk 2 , we are happy with where we are, but it’s still too early to give a specific date and plan on when we will move onto full production,” Gnaś said.

CD Projekt Red beginning full development on Cyberpunk 2 in 2028 would actually make a ton of sense, as this year is also the same one in which The Witcher 4 is planned to release . While The Witcher 4 will almost certainly continue to receive new content and updates after its arrival, much of CDPR will certainly begin shifting its focus to the studio’s next major game, which will be that of Cyberpunk 2 .

Assuming that things play out in this manner, this would result in Cyberpunk 2 not actually releasing until well after 2030. Given the sheer scale that Cyberpunk 2 will certainly have, the game will almost certainly have to be in production for a period of three to five years. This puts it on track to not launch until the next generation of consoles becomes available.

Still, even if Cyberpunk 2 is this far down the road, CD Projekt Red could begin teasing it a bit sooner. The original Cyberpunk 2077 had its first teaser trailers emerge years before the game ever saw the light of day. While there’s always the chance that CDPR might not want to go about things in this same way, it leaves the door open for Cyberpunk 2 being revealed in some capacity in the months or year to come.

How do you feel about Cyberpunk 2 based on what CDPR has said now? And when do you think that this ucpoming RPG will actually release? Be sure to let me know down in the comments section.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2 Is Still a Ways Out, but CD Projekt Red Says Its RPGs Will Come Out Faster in the Future
items.summary: We are still two years out from The Witcher 4, but Ciri's big breakout adventure isn't the only massive RPG cooking at CD Projekt Red. It sounds like development on Cyberpunk 2 is carrying on smoothly, though it's still very early in its development cycle.
items.content:
We are still two years out from The Witcher 4 , but Ciri's big breakout adventure isn't the only massive RPG cooking at CD Projekt Red. It sounds like development on Cyberpunk 2 is carrying on smoothly, though it's still very early in its development cycle.

In a November 24 earnings call , CD Projekt Red VP of Strategy & Investor Relations Karolina Gnaś said the team is "making good progress with Cyberpunk 2, we are happy with where we are, but it's still too early to give a specific date and plan on when we will move onto full production." Although she couldn't provide a clear date when we'll hear more about the game, she did add that the studio plans to have around 200 developers by the end of 2026 and 320 by the end of next year.

It is admittedly a bit early to expect any kind of information about the Cyberpunk sequel, but it has been simmering in the background since at least 2022 , and it sounds like CD Projekt Red wants to speed up development of its massive RPGs. In its consolidated earnings report , CD Projekt Red admitted that most of its games "normally take 3 to 6 years to produce," mostly due to working on one game at a time. But that strategy has since changed.

In that same report, the company said, "At the moment, the CD Projekt Red studio is working in parallel on several productions (also in collaboration with external development teams) and supporting products, which is expected to translate into shorter intervals between the releases of subsequent titles in the future." Whether or not that new timeline will affect Cyberpunk 2 is the question.

But even if that faster development timeline is in effect for Cyberpunk 2, it's likely we'll still have to wait a while to actually see it in the wild. In an earnings report last year, when Cyberpunk 2 entered pre-production, CD Projekt CEO Michał Nowakowski suggested that CDPR's games take four or five years to move from pre-production to release, which would put the game somewhere in 2030 or 2031. And given that the game still hasn't entered full production, it isn't likely we're going to see some sort of rapid release after the Witcher 4 in 2028.

We're probably going to be waiting a little while longer for Cyberpunk 2, but it's already sounding like the game is taking shape. Just last month, associate game director Pawel Sasko revealed that a lot of the developers working on Cyberpunk 2 are former modders. Sasko went on to claim that "the modding community is really keeping [Cyberpunk 2077] alive," so hopefully that energy translates to Cyberpunk 2 – whenever it comes out.

items.title: CD Projekt RED Signs Sony Deal Covering The Witcher 4 Marketing and PlayStation Plus, After Partnering With Xbox on Cyberpunk 2077
items.summary: CD Projekt RED announced to have signed a deal with Sony for the marketing of The Witcher 4 and to bring some of its games to PS Plus.
items.content:
CD Projekt RED has just released its Q3 2026 earnings report, delivering a few interesting news tidbits. Perhaps the most interesting one is that they have signed a new partnership with Sony :

On November 24, 2026, the Company signed new partnership agreements with Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC, covering the availability of our games on PlayStation platforms and through PlayStation Plus subscription services, as well as collaboration on the marketing campaign for The Witcher 4.

Speaking during the earnings webcast , CD Projekt RED's Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Piotr Nielubowicz added:

This cooperation will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years.

Clearly, the Polish studio was looking to sign some sort of partnership to help sustain its substantial development efforts. Indeed, development expenses climbed from $282.38 million at the end of 2025 to $417.05 million as of September 30, 2026, driven primarily by The Witcher 4 , Cyberpunk 2 , and the upcoming The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past DLC.

This is a change for CD Projekt RED, which had partnered with Xbox on both The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077. This time around, Sony must have simply offered more money . It's yet another big marketing deal for them, following Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI, and it fills the Call of Duty void, which is now solely marketed through Xbox. Of course, nothing will change regarding release: the game will be available on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series S|X, at some point in 2028.

CDPR Joint CEO Michał Nowakowski talked about the highly successful second season of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , which once again boosted player numbers in the game (reaching 187K concurrent Steam players , its highest since October 2023) with the help of the tie-in 2.5 update :

The Edgerunners brand is a product in its own right, with an audience that reaches well beyond our player base. The anime brings people to the franchise, the update gives them a new reason to play, and the game brings them back for more.

Nowakowski also boasted about the many nominations received at The Game Awards 2026 :

I am proud to say that we have been nominated in four categories at The Game Awards - three of these nominations are tied to the Witcher universe. This means a world to us. It’s great to see The Witcher franchise receiving such strong recognition.

CD Projekt RED's overall workforce is stable, growing by only 6 employees from July to October. The total headcount is now 1051 , of which slightly less than half are busy on The Witcher 4, while nearly 200 are on Cyberpunk 2, 60 on Sirius (the multiplayer The Witcher), and 34 are working on the new IP, Project Hadar .

In other fresh CDPR-related news, the Creative Director of Cyberpunk 2 was so astonished by Grand Theft Auto VI that he joked the game was thus canceled . Meanwhile, the developers of The Witcher 4 said the game will need to appeal to a broader audience while remaining a true RPG.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Sequel Gets Exciting Official Development Update
items.summary: Fans of the franchise are in for a treat.
items.content:
Add ScreenRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover By Ben Brosofsky Published Nov 24, 2026, 2:53 PM EST Ben Brosofsky has been writing for Screen Rant since 2022 and editing since 2024. He graduated from Vanderbilt University with a Bachelor's in Cinema & Media Arts. Writing serves as a much-needed distraction from tackling a backlog of Steam games that will never be surmounted. Sign in to your ScreenRant account Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Cyberpunk 2077 's sequel is just one of several projects currently in the works at developer CD Projekt Red, but the latest news suggests that it's time for fans of the franchise to start getting excited about the game. While The Witcher 4 is set to launch before Night City (or another location in the surrounding world ) makes a return, the winds are now changing.

The update on the subject comes courtesy of CDPR's public sharing of project allocation, which highlights where the studio's current resources are going in their announced (and possibly unannounced) plans. In the latest post, Cyberpunk 2 's production team size has increased, indicating that development is continuing to gear up.

A female V walks among a crowd in Cyberpunk 2077 artwork. A post from the official CD Projekt Red IR X Account compares project allocation stats from October 31, 2026, to earlier numbers from July 21, 2026, and Cyberpunk 2 is the clear winner here. While the overall number of developers working at CDPR has only increased by six, the size of the team working on Cyberpunk 2 has increased by 15, pulling some staff from other projects at CDPR to bring the count from 184 to 199.

The Witcher 4 team is still the largest by a wide margin, with 513 members, but that number is slightly down from 519 earlier this year. Meanwhile, the multiplayer Witcher project codenamed Sirius has lost the most staff members, shrinking from 84 developers to 60. A new IP codenamed Hadar gained one developer, and the broader "Shared Services" category increased from 196 to 212.

While none of these shifts are massive, it does indicate that Cyberpunk 2 is presumably continuing to pick up momentum, and the growing numbers suggest that it's much further along in development than Hadar is. Once The Witcher 4 launches — right now, it's targeting a 2028 release — a large portion of the staff currently working on that game may move to Cyberpunk 2 to speed along its development.

In a more general sense, it's impressive to see just how big CDPR is at this point, as the studio had much fewer resources when it kicked off The Witcher series in 2007. The company has steadily grown over the years alongside its games, delivering increasingly ambitious titles that pull in larger and larger audiences.

Cyberpunk 2077 , admittedly, was seen by many as a step back from The Witcher 3 at launch, with bugs and performance issues (especially on last-generation consoles) and somewhat underwhelming RPG elements. Over the years, though, updates have delivered significantly more of what fans wanted from the experience, which bodes well for the sequel.

It could still be a while before we see a substantial teaser for the Cyberpunk 2077 sequel, let alone any material from the game itself. The wait from the cinematic teaser trailer for the first game to its eventual release, along with the ultimately different vibe of the finished product, only compounded disappointments at launch. Hopefully, whenever CDPR finally decides to show off the sequel, it will be ready to arrive in the near future.

items.title: Waiting for GTA 6 on PC? These 5 games capture some of its magic
items.summary: It's probably going to be a year or more before you get the biggest game in the world on PC. Here are some alternatives that cover at least some of the same bases.
items.content:
Wow, between Grand Theft Auto VI and the stunning remake of Ocarina of Time , it’s been a while since PC gamers felt so left out, huh? It’ll probably be a year before the biggest game piece of media in history lands on our computing shores — and therefore a year before anyone gets to play it at more than 30 frames per second. But assuming you don’t have a PS5 or Xbox, what should you play in the meantime?

Welcome to the Boost Mode newsletter. Every week I share my insights on PC gaming, desktop setups, and hardware optimization. I also track down some of the most interesting PC and nerd news from around the web, plus a PC game pick you might not have seen elsewhere. Want this newsletter to come directly to your inbox? Sign up on our website !

Frankly, GTA VI is so ridiculously huge and detailed that I don’t think anything on the market will scratch that particular itch. I mean, how many city-based sandbox games can claim to accurately render every single bolt and rivet in a cell phone tower ? But I have made a few selections to give you at least some of the vibes of the game,

I’ll go to bat for Just Cause any day: I think it’s more fun than GTA . The series doesn’t have any of the life simulator or deep role-playing elements of the games it clearly takes inspiration from. But it does let you steal a plane from an airport, pop out on top of the cockpit and ride it like a bucking bronco, smash it into the side of a mountain, and then shoot a grappling hook onto the military helicopter that chased you down.

Just Cause 3 isn’t the most recent game in the series, but I think it’s the best thanks to its setting and focus. There’s technically a story, in the sense that Steven Seagal movies technically have characters. You get infinite parachutes, wingsuits, and grappling hooks — it’s possible to steal cars and drive them around, but why bother? Your mission is to essentially blow up everything in the country that’s capable of blowing up, and then a few more things too. Also, it’s $3 at the time of writing, c’mooooon.

I don’t think there’s a deeper, more intriguiging role-playing setup than Disco Elysium , bar none. That comes with some qualifiers. This is a turn-based role-playing game, broadly inspired by tabletop RPGs, so don’t expect to do sick tricks on a motorcycle on your way to a heist — there’s very little actual combat in this game. But there’s no better game for really sinking your teeth into a character.

In Disco Elysium you play a police detective with amnesia in a world that resembles our own, but has a completely independent history. And the setup has you exploring both the setting and yourself with total freedom, including the freedom to fail spectacularly. If you ever wanted the experience of playing through a blend of Tolstoy and True Detective , this will give it to you.

Die Bedeutung von Video-RAM (VRAM) steigt bei Grafikkarten. Vor allem Open-World-Spiele wie beispielsweise Red Dead Redemption 2 benötigen viel VRAM für die beste Optik. Derzeit reichen 8 GB Kapazität für aktuelle Spiele noch aus.

Is it cheating to recommend Rockstar’s last game if you can’t play its newest one? Maybe, but if what you really like about GTA is the intrigue of a life of crime, then you probably can’t do better than the cowboy version. And if you’ve never played it, Red Dead Redemption 2 is technically a prequel to the first game, so you can also jump in cold to absorb the story.

RDR2 shares a lot of the same DNA as both Grand Theft Auto V and VI , with wide-open sandboxes and deep systems for both standard gameplay and all the trimmings. Players are still finding hidden details and story beats years after the game came out. If you’re up for a little more The Godfather and a little less The Fast and the Furious , this is the way to go.

3D environmental sounds add to a captivating atmosphere in Cyberpunk 2077.

If any recent game has rivaled GTA in terms of scope and feel, it’s probably Cyberpunk 2077 . While it’s an original title set in the world of a sci-fi tabletop RPG, it isn’t shy about its sandbox inspirations, at least in terms of its open world and crime simulation. If what you love about GTA is how it lets you drive around and do crazy stuff while running from the cops, Cyberpunk delivers on that in spades.

With vehicle-based shooting and hacking, you arguably have a lot more options, at least if you invest your skill points in the right build. And Night City and the surrounding desert is one of the richest and most interesting game worlds on the market. Oh, and did I mention it’ll run at 60 frames per second (or more)? Nice.

Polymega Speaking of weird gaming hacks, you can load up SteamOS on the MacBook Neo, if you want. You shouldn’t — this is the Arm-based version of the OS , adapted from the Steam Frame, and it’s barely even running. But you can try. If you’re still holding onto Windows 7… well, let it go, c’mon. But now you can use DirectX12 and the latest graphics cards on the 17-year-old operating system if you want, thanks to some community drivers. Each Glamdoc is located in a unique shop, along with their own intro scene with voiceover and animations, and offers a unique catalog of cyberware skins with customizable colors.

    [/*]

  • Sometimes one gun just isn't enough. The new Double Trouble perk in the Cool tree (along with four auxiliary perks) introduces an entirely new playstyle, allowing you to dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers from the Power category.

    [/*]

  • Added frames from the Cyberpunk Trading Card Game to Photo Mode, allowing you to make your preem shots look like custom cards.

    [/*]

  • Added new poses in Photo Mode to show off your dual-wielding prowess.

    [/*]

Mod the World

Added Cross-Platform Mod Support, powered by mod.io, a first step into cross-platform modding that allows you to easily browse and install a selection of player-created mods directly from the in-game menu. More mods will become available over time. The feature is available on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S.

Upgrading the World

  • Welcome to Paradise! Added a new side quest that takes you on a journey to uncover a mystery and explore Night City on a guided tour narrated by Richard Night. It unlocks after completing The Heist and reaching level 15 Street Cred.

    [/*]

  • Added 12 new Minor Arcana Tarot Cards to discover across Night City. The Tarot menu now has separate sections for Major and Minor Arcana. The new tarot cards are part of a new side quest, an extension of Fool on the Hill, which activates after scanning any of the new cards. Collect them all to get a special reward.

    [/*]

Quality of Life

  • Saves in the “Load Game” menu are now grouped by separate playthroughs.

    [/*]

  • Added item filters to apartment and vehicle stashes.

    [/*]

  • Modded saves in the "Load Game" menu are now marked with a dedicated icon. Please note that achievements and trophies cannot be earned while playing on console from a modded save file.

    [/*]

  • Updated the selection of AMD FSR options. FSR 3 upscaling is no longer included, while FSR 2.1, FSR 4, and FSR 3.1 Frame Generation remain available.

    [/*]

  • Updated the CD PROJEKT RED Account connection, My Rewards and telemetry consent menus.

    [/*]

Technology

  • Added support for DLSS 4.5, including up to 6X Multi Frame Generation or Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and the 2nd Generation Transformer Model.

    [/*]

  • Added support for glasses-free 3D effects on compatible Samsung Odyssey 3D monitors, along with a Motion Comfort setting that lets you balance 3D depth and viewing comfort.

    [/*]

  • Added support for MetalFX Frame Interpolation on Mac.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle in settings for FSR Anti-Lag 2.

    [/*]

  • Introduced various performance optimizations, including improvements specifically for Ray Tracing.

    [/*]

  • Improved HDR rendering to provide more accurate colors, brightness, and contrast on compatible displays.

    [/*]

Fixes

  • Things Done Changed- Fixed an issue where the Delamain cab could get stuck after crashing into another vehicle, blocking quest progression.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where enabling Film Grain had no effect.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where tagging enemies while scanning could also cause V to crouch or stand up when using certain control schemes.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where controller settings for the Third-Person Camera were missing.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several typos in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added various other fixes for features and content introduced since Patch 2.1.

    [/*]

items.content:
To survive in Night City, you need someone to watch your back. On the way to the major leagues, V managed to gather a remarkable crew. You could even say, a crew to remember!

From trusted allies to unforgettable personalities, these are the people who helped shape V’s journey through the City of Dreams. This episode of It’s All About You is dedicated to the legendary crew that stood by V through every high and low.

Thank you for staying with us and expressing your love for Cyberpunk 2077 in the most creative ways possible. Don’t forget to check out our gallery to see more works, and, of course, share your creations with us: http://cdpred.ly/AAY

See you in the next episode!

items.title: It’s All About You! — Never Fade Away

items.content:
Listen up, Samurai! 🤘🔥

Celebrate five years of Cyberpunk 2077 in this special anniversary episode of It’s All About You, looking back on Night City’s unforgettable stories through the legends and music you met along your journey!

Sure, the city’s full of noise — sirens, synths, gunfire in the distance — but if there’s one song that became its soul, it’s “Never Fade Away.”

We brought together legendary artists from across the city of dreams to reinterpret this iconic track — each in their own voice, their own style, their own rebellion. ❤️‍🔥

Plug in, turn it up, and dive into our latest It’s All About You episode.

Because legends don’t fade.
